title: Understanding Required vs Optional Fields
query: Send a notification to john@company.com about the meeting

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Send a notification to a user

explanation: The schema shows only 'recipient' and 'message' are REQUIRED (in the 'required' array). The fields 'priority' and 'send_email' are OPTIONAL with default values, so we don't need to include them. Only provide what's required + what's explicitly mentioned in the query.
learning_points: The 'required' array in a schema tells you which fields MUST be provided
Optional fields can be omitted - they'll use their default values
Don't add fields just because they exist - only add what's needed
Default values (shown in descriptions) are applied automatically
hints: priority and send_email are optional (not in required array)
Only provide required fields unless the query specifically mentions optional ones
